logline: 空房還在。留不是重播——是把雨後那一間房，再聽深一層。
youtubeTitle: [playlist] QuietLY · 留 — Empty Room After Rain / Slow Mandarin Jazz (Room Remix)

comics.en: The empty room is still here.
It is listening one layer deeper after rain.
comics.zh: 是把雨後那一間房，再聽深一層。

comics.en: Ten remixed corners, ten new ones of the same night.
comics.zh: 十首再聽，十個同一夜的新角落。
